description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillService class, which provides methods to interact with EmployeeSkillDao for employee skill data management within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillService
classes.description: Service class for handling business logic related to employee skills, acting as an intermediary between controllers and data access objects.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of EmployeeSkillDao, creating it if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeSkillDao instance used by this service.
